notes: The first DOCX fixture. Derived by reading the document's own paragraphs and styles, never from pipeline output.

A DOCX has no coordinates at all, so every geometric rule in the pipeline has to take its structural path here. What the document states instead is stronger: 'Heading 1' marks each section outright, and there is nothing to infer from font size or vertical gaps.
Bullets carry a literal '• ' in the run text rather than a list style, so the marker regex sees them exactly as it would in a PDF. The list-style path is exercised by a unit test instead.
Every experience record is two lines: 'Title | Dates' then 'Company | Location', both pipe-separated. There is no right-hand column, because a DOCX has no columns.
The phone number is deliberately redacted in the source as '+66 8X XXX XXXX', so no phone is expected.
The trailing 'Synthetic resume created for ATS / parser testing' line is a disclaimer in the body, not a page footer -- a DOCX footer lives in a separate part and never reaches the body text.
